Working Model: Hybrid, with onsite working 2–3 days per week.
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 am–6 pm.
Contract type: Full-time, Permanent
 
Please note: For this position, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future. Candidates must already have the permanent legal right to work in the country they apply to and be able to start and maintain employment without visa support from Convera.

As a Compliance Operations Associate at Convera based in our Vilnius office, you will be fully trained to investigate and analyze corporate customers to make sure they meet all necessary requirements, legislation, and policies. After gathering all the required information about the customers, you will decide whether to pursue or terminate the business relationship with them. Here you will have an opportunity to work and develop in a professional multicultural environment.

You will be responsible for:

• Ensuring all new or existing all new or existing corporate customers meet Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, legislation, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policies
• Updating profiles of our customer accounts and keeping records up-to-date
• Efficient internal communication to gather KYC information
• Keeping internal procedural documentation up-to-date
• Additional ad-hoc tasks
• Supporting your colleagues and management with training new staff, audit requests, projects, documentation

You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in Operations, Know Your customer, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering or relevant field
• Excellent communication skills, write in English and French clearly, effectively, and quickly
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and client-centric mindset
• Initiative and commitment to overcome obstacles and meet the end goal, targets
• Flexible working approach, strong decision making, and influencing skills
• The ability to work successfully in a self-motivated team environment
• Client centric

About Convera

Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs.

Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. 

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:

• Market competitive monthly gross salary starting from 2,100 EUR (depending on experience and qualifications)
• Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization
• A flexible approach to work (6-10 days per month in the office)
• Generous insurance (health, disability, life) 
• Paid holidays, time-off, and leave policies for life events (maternity, paternity, adoption)
• Work from abroad 60 days per year
• 3 wellness days per year
• Paid volunteering opportunities (5 days per year)

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you’re ready to unleash your potential.

Fraud Prevention Specialist



About us 

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing 

As our Fraud Prevention Specialist, you'll protect Satispay’s users and assets by mastering fraud detection and prevention across Cards, SEPA Direct Debit (SDD), and other payment schemes, keeping financial and reputational losses to a minimum while preserving a seamless user experience. Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Transaction Surveillance & Alert Review - Actively monitor multi-channel transaction flows (Cards and SEPA vectors), review real-time and ex-post alert queues, and swiftly resolve suspicious activities across customer portfolios.

 - Emerging Threat & Trend Identification - Analyse transactional behaviours, velocity patterns, and scheme returns (SDD R-transactions, card chargebacks) to proactively uncover new attack vectors and vulnerabilities.

 - Rule Engineering & Logic Refinement - Translate ground-level fraud insights into actionable requirements; collaborate with the Fraud Strategy team to design, test, and calibrate transaction monitoring rules to boost detection and minimise false positives.

 - Loss & Reputational Impact Prevention - Intercept fraudulent behaviours early in the lifecycle to safeguard Satispay from direct financial exposure, scheme non-compliance, and brand risk.

 - Negative Balance & Debt Recovery Management - Manage the operational lifecycle of negative balances resulting from fraud or return flows, executing structured collection processes and recovering value for the business.

 - UX & Friction Calibration - Partner with Product teams to ensure fraud controls and step-up authentication methods strike the right balance between risk mitigation and a smooth user journey.

 - Data Collection & Insights Sharing - Gather, structure, and synthesise fraud loss and transaction data to generate actionable insights and performance metrics for cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Incident Escalation & Forensic Triage - Conduct deep-dive triage on complex card/SDD fraud schemes and escalate critical vectors or systematic exploits for rapid remediation.



Who we're looking for 

This role needs someone operationally sharp and data-minded who understands digital payment mechanics and brings high vigilance to protecting customer accounts and assets.

 - Experience - 2 to 4 years in fraud operations or transaction monitoring within fintech, digital banking, or payment processing ecosystems.

 - Payment Scheme Expertise - Solid understanding of payment mechanics, specifically Card processing flows, SEPA Direct Debit (SDD) return cycles, and velocity/pattern monitoring techniques.

 - Rule Design & Data Literacy - Proficiency in querying transactional datasets and spotting anomalies using analytics tools (such as Looker, HEX, or SQL) to shape logic for automated detection scenarios.

 - Recovery & Loss Management - Familiarity with negative balance recovery management, chargeback operational handling, or structured debt collection workflows.

 - UX & Risk Balance - Product-sensitive approach to applying fraud controls without introducing unnecessary user friction.

 - Analytical Communication - Ability to synthesise complex fraud insights and transactional patterns into clear, structured feedback for Strategy, Product, and Engineering teams.

 - Core Mindset - High resilience under alert volumes, strong attention to detail, sound ethical judgment, and a proactive attitude toward investigating emerging attack vectors.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.



CareAbout: how we support your impact 

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

 - 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

 - ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

 - 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.



Equal opportunity employer At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Role/ Department:  

Client Onboarding Consultant.
 

The role sits within the Transformation function. The function combines deep functional and business expertise to support large-scale transformational programmes across the organization. The role helps define and drive strategy and innovative solutions that address current and future business challenges and support the achievement of organizational objectives. It also considers corporate strategic initiatives collectively, connecting them into a holistic roadmap and ensuring alignment with the broader enterprise direction. 

 
The key responsibilities of the role include: 


The Fund Event Team is central to the ongoing success of our business growth as we are the pivot point between our clients and our operational teams during the project management of our client’s fund event initiatives. It is a highly dynamic and evolving role at the forefront of new products, regulatory changes and shifting client needs.  

  • Active management of direct and indirect communications with clients, service providers, fund management companies, custodians, portfolio managers and brokers in order to successfully run fund events in line with the defined scope and time 
  • Helping to coordinate the operations teams involved in fund events (launches, mergers, migrations, liquidations…); 
  • Ensuring that events are coordinated through the whole production life-cycle of the fund by using established best practices and project tools; 
  • Maintaining project plans, RAID logs, runbooks and any other project related documentation; 
  • Identifying and escalating issues including system functionality, data availability, resource availability and the scope or scale of on-going projects; 
  • Assist the Client Service Delivery Managers in identifying any changes to service level reporting or deviation from standard operating models raised in the project environment to ensure they are captured appropriately in service level agreements. 

 
Skills/Qualifications: 

The successful candidate will benefit from having: 

 

  • Excellent analytical, interpersonal and organizational skills; 
  • Inquisitive by nature and a fast learner; 
  • A good understanding of the financial industry, especially funds and asset servicing, from an operational and business perspective; 
  • The ability to stay focused and analytical under pressure; 
  • Flexibility and adaptability in dealing with an evolving operating model and with an evolving business environment; 
  • Able to prioritize business requirements to manage deliveries within agreed deadlines; 
  • Excellent at communicating; both in writing and verbally in English. French and/or German would be desirable.

 


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.


About Our Luxembourg Office


In 2024, the Northern Trust Luxembourg office celebrated their 20th anniversary, an important chapter in their history. Having opened in 2004 to support one client, they have since grown their client base substantially and increased their headcount significantly, which now stands at over 400.


From modern fully equipped meeting rooms to a vast canteen with a view over a vegetable garden, maintained by our team all year round, and a rooftop where beehives have been installed, this space is truly a source of pride for our team. Learn more.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for the enforcement of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) standards and the assessment of unusual activities. 

YOUR CHALLENGE

  • Review and document all aspects of the client relationship and take appropriate compliance actions and adequate risk mitigating and remediation measures
  • Interact with senior stakeholders within Compliance and other parts of the organisation as well as with the group’s international locations
  • Perform ad-hoc investigations and enhanced due diligence on defined risk categories and on complex cases
  • Perform employee-related investigations and reviews in order to propose mitigating measures and sanctions in close collaboration with HR and the business (Employee Coverage)
  • Perform comprehensive background checks, assess and document the sources of information critically
  • Escalate issues identified along the review process, while initiating and monitoring mitigation measures to reduce the bank’s risk exposure
  • Collaborate with partners across all three Lines of Defence (Front, Compliance and Internal Audit), as well as other functions (Relationship Managers, Front Risk Management, etc.) and domestic and foreign group affiliate
  • Provide training and training materials in connection with Compliance topics
  • Recommend, develop, and implement solutions to support continuous improvement of our processes, procedures, and services
  • Responsible for fraud prevention and detection activities and ownership for the internal and external Fraud Risk Type Framework (Employee Coverage specific only)

 

Transaction Monitoring (role specific)

    • Independently review unusual transactions detected by the IT-based AML monitoring system, analyse their economic background and assess if the transaction is in line with the client’s KYC (Know Your Customer) profile
    • Undertake additional clarifications if deemed required (e.g. investigate with the front units, run adverse information checks of the ordering party and/or beneficiary of the transaction, request and review corroboration documents etc.)
    • Review corroboration documents and assess negative news (including assessment of reliability of the source)

 

Private Banking Compliance (role specific)

    • Support Relationship Managers and Leadership in the implementation and supervision of Compliance issues
    • Perform client onboarding reviews including assessment of KYC, client storyline, flow of funds, CDB (Agreement on the Swiss banks’ code of conduct with regard to the exercise of due diligence), as well event triggered KYC reviews
    • Follow up on outstanding onboarding issues and escalations
    • Identify and investigate serious cases of non-compliance
    • Provide training and training materials in connection with compliance topics

YOUR PROFILE

  • Ability to effectively apply working knowledge of global AML and CFT (Combating the Financing of Terrorism) regulations and standards, current money laundering schemes to effectively identify and mitigate risks
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions: ability to interpret an extensive variety of data and deal with complex situations
  • Ability to communicate unpopular opinions/decisions and to stay firm under pressure
  • Proven track record of solving highly complex problems, decision-making and prioritizations abilities
  • Solution-oriented and very strong analytical skills
  • Exhibit sound judgment and discretion
  • Good knowledge of MS Office and IT-flair
  • Several years of expert experience in Legal and Compliance or Audit at a globally operating Bank
  • University degree (Law or Business Administration) or equivalent

Arendt Investor Services (AIS) is the investor services’ arm of Arendt. We help clients to efficiently run the operational side of their business, bringing peace of mind to investors. Equipped with the latest technology, our 300 experts provide clients with an integrated suite of fund and corporate services, delivered to the highest market standards.

Our services complement Arendt’s legal expertise and regulatory & consulting services. We are a Professional of the Financial Sector (PFS) supervised by the CSSF and ISO 22301 certified.

The experts at AIS and AManco provide clients with: Corporate Services, Fund Administration Services, Governance Services, Operational AML & Compliance Services, Tax Compliance Services, Depositary Services, as well as Third Party AIFM Services (provided by AManco S.A.).

Given the ongoing development of AIS, we are currently recruiting:

‎ 


Senior Officer - Client Onboarding


Corporate & Fund Services

 

Your role:

 

As part of our Client Onboarding team, you will play a key role in managing and coordinating the end-to-end onboarding of new clients and client conversions, ensuring a smooth, efficient and high-quality experience throughout the process.

 

Your responsibilities will include:

 

  • Manage and coordinate onboarding projects from initiation through completion, acting as a central point of contact for clients and relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate on a day-to-day basis with prospective clients, internal teams, lawyers, notaries, banks and other service providers to ensure the timely progression of onboarding activities.
  • Independently manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously, including complex and time-sensitive onboardings, while effectively prioritising competing deadlines, actions and dependencies.
  • Coordinate the drafting, review and negotiation of service agreements and contribute to the review of fund offering documentation in collaboration with the relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Work closely with our KYC/AML experts responsible for performing the initial due diligence on prospective clients and coordinate the collection of the information and documentation required for client acceptance.
  • Take ownership of the overall onboarding experience and ensure that clients receive a consistent, responsive and high-quality service throughout their onboarding journey.
  • Lead regular project and status calls with clients and stakeholders, maintain onboarding project plans, monitor key milestones and dependencies, follow up on outstanding actions and proactively identify potential blockers.
  • Provide clear and regular reporting on the status of ongoing onboardings and conversions, including key outstanding items, risks and matters requiring escalation or management attention.
  • Ensure that client information and onboarding records are accurately and consistently maintained in our internal systems and databases.
  • Work closely with Senior Management and provide visibility on client requirements, expectations, challenges and emerging needs.
  • Demonstrate sound judgement in resolving day-to-day onboarding matters, taking ownership of issues and involving or escalating to the relevant specialists or Senior Management where appropriate.
  • Identify and contribute to process improvements and initiatives aimed at increasing efficiency, consistency and the overall client experience.
  • Proactively contribute to finding practical solutions to client needs during onboarding and support the development of strong and lasting client relationships.

 

 

Your profile:

 

  • You ideally hold a degree in Business Management, Law, Economics, Finance or a related field.
  • You have approximately 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in the financial services, fund services, asset services or corporate services environment, with meaningful exposure to client interactions.
  • You have experience in coordinating or managing client onboarding, implementation, conversion or other multi-stakeholder projects.
  • You have strong knowledge of Fund Services, Asset Services and/or Corporate Services and a good understanding of the Luxembourg financial services environment.
  • You are familiar with KYC/AML requirements and have an interest in continuing to develop your knowledge of the regulatory environment, particularly in relation to Financial Crime.
  • You have excellent relationship management and communication skills and are confident interacting with clients as well as internal and external stakeholders.
  • You are highly organised, rigorous and able to manage several projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • You demonstrate a high degree of autonomy, ownership and accountability and are comfortable driving matters forward proactively.
  • You have strong problem-solving skills and sound judgement, with the ability to identify issues, propose practical solutions and escalate matters appropriately.
  • You are dynamic, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • You have a positive, collaborative and enthusiastic attitude and are committed to turning every client interaction into an opportunity to deliver an excellent client experience.
  • You are fluent in English. Fluency in French and/or German would be considered an advantage.

Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Technology GRC Lead

  • Location: Madrid or London

Role Overview

Technology is accountable to Internal Audit, Compliance, and Risk for how it manages technology risk and meets its regulatory obligations. This role directly owns that accountability.

You will lead the Technology GRC programme, maintaining Tech’s overall compliance posture, providing a centralised view of risks, controls, and audit findings, and integrating GRC priorities directly into the core Technology roadmap.

Reporting to the Head of Security Engineering, you will serve as the primary liaison between Technology and internal/external oversight bodies (Internal Audit, Compliance, IT Risk), representing the department at executive risk committees.

Key Responsibilities

Technology GRC Programme Management

  • Own the Programme: Drive Technology’s compliance posture and establish a single source of truth for technology risk and compliance metrics.

  • Centralise Requests: Manage and triage incoming audit, risk, and compliance inquiries across Technology and Engineering, setting coordinated response strategies and holding stakeholders accountable.

  • Maintain Risk Registers: Administer the Technology risk register in AuditBoard, ensuring risk ratings, control mappings, and action plans are actively maintained and agreed upon by risk owners.

  • Governance & Reporting: Represent Technology at risk committees, delivering data-driven reporting on KPIs, risk positions, and remediation progress.

Audit, Assurance & Control Frameworks

  • Audit Execution: Lead internal and external audits end-to-end—from initial scoping and evidence coordination to remediation and closure.

  • Remediation Tracking: Enforce agreed remediation timelines across engineering teams, escalating proactively to senior leadership when target dates slip.

  • Control Design: Align and define the Technology control framework against industry standards (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS) and applicable regulatory mandates.

  • Policy Governance: Author, update, and manage the approval lifecycle for Technology policies, standards, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Engineering Integration & Automation

  • Roadmap Alignment: Translate findings, risks, and regulatory deadlines into concrete deliverables within the Technology product and engineering backlogs.

  • Resource Allocation: Partner with Technology Directors during planning cycles to ensure compliance tasks are prioritised alongside feature work.

  • Compliance as Code: Collaborate with engineering teams to implement automated control validation and continuous evidence collection, minimising manual compliance overhead.

Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

  • Vendor Assessments: Lead security and risk evaluations for technology vendors, software providers, and SaaS tools.

  • Contractual Standards: Define mandatory security clauses and compliance requirements during vendor onboarding and contract negotiations.

What You’ll Bring

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years in IT/Cybersecurity GRC, IT Risk, or IT Audit—ideally within a regulated environment (such as financial services or fintech).

  • End-to-End Ownership: Proven track record of independently leading technology audits and risk programmes, rather than solely performing administrative support.

  • Framework Fluency: Practical working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS, along with a firm grasp of IT General Controls (ITGCs) across access management, change management, and IT operations.

  • Technical Credibility: Solid technical grounding in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), IAM, CI/CD pipelines, and secure SDLC to evaluate risk and challenge technical assertions objectively.

  • Executive Presence: Proven ability to present complex risk metrics, dashboards, and positions to risk committees and senior executives.

  • Stakeholder Management: High diplomatic assertiveness—comfortable holding senior stakeholders to remediation dates and escalating objectively when required.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to bridge conversations between software engineers and non-technical auditors.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience administering modern GRC platforms (e.g., AuditBoard).

  • Familiarity with regulations and frameworks such as DORA, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 (Type II).

  • Experience implementing automated compliance monitoring or evidence pipelines.

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor).

About us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally. 

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team. 

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage. 

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:
Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.

Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.
